Equivalently, the $n$th second $K$-gonal number $n\bigl((K-2)n + (K-4)\bigr)/2$, the $K$-gonal formula $m\bigl((K-2)m - (K-4)\bigr)/2$ at $m = -n$, equals this number of paths.

Equivalently, it is the number of positions of $w$ at which an occurrence of $f$ as a contiguous block starts, overlapping occurrences all being counted; in particular the empty word has factor count $|w| + 1$ in $w$.
